Services

SMSF setup and administration

A self-managed super fund puts you in the trustee’s chair — up to six members, your own investment strategy, and a compliance cycle that arrives every year whether the fund did anything or not.

Our fee

from $749 to establish, inc. GST

Fixed, agreed in writing, no work begins before you accept it.

Government charges

ASIC and ATO levies

A corporate trustee carries an ASIC registration fee, and the ATO’s annual supervisory levy is paid with the return. Both are quoted with our fee.

Who does it

A registered tax agent

BRS Advisory Pty Ltd, agent 26233684. The annual audit is done by an independent auditor, never by us.

What’s included

  • Whether an SMSF is worth it at your balance — the costs are largely fixed, so often it is not
  • Trust deed, and the trustee structure: individual trustees, or a corporate trustee
  • Registration with the ATO within 60 days of establishment, including the election to be regulated
  • TFN, ABN, bank account and electronic service address
  • Trustee declarations signed within 21 days and kept on file
  • An investment strategy that is written down, and reviewed rather than filed and forgotten
  • Annual financial statements, member statements and the SMSF annual return
  • An independent approved auditor appointed for you, at least 45 days before the return is due

How it runs

  1. 01 Verify identity online — each director, trustee or controlling owner does a three-minute check on their phone, included in the fee. Every client, every service, no exceptions. How it works.
  2. 02 We start with whether the fund is worth it for you. Set-up and annual costs barely move with balance, so the smaller the balance the harder they are to justify.
  3. 03 Deed executed, trustees appointed, and the trustee declarations signed within 21 days.
  4. 04 Registered with the ATO within 60 days of establishment, with the TFN, ABN, bank account and ESA in place.
  5. 05 Each year: accounts, independent audit, then the annual return. A new fund’s first return is generally due 28 February; after that the agent date is 15 May.

Two things we will be straight about

We prepare and administer, and we do not audit our own work. The law requires an approved SMSF auditor who is registered with ASIC and independent of the fund, so we appoint one for you. That audit is required every financial year — including a year in which the fund received no contributions and paid nothing out.

And on scope: establishing and running the fund is accounting, tax and compliance work, which is what we do. Whether an SMSF suits your circumstances, and what it should invest in, is financial product advice. We are not licensed to give that, we will say so plainly rather than drift into it, and we can point you to someone who is.

Start it

Tell us where your super is now and what you are trying to do with it. We will come back with a fixed fee and, if the numbers say a fund is not worth it for you, we will tell you that instead — at no charge.

Get a quote Contact Us

Prefer to talk it through? Call 0407 179 179 and we will take the details over the phone. Please don’t include your tax file number either way — we ask for it securely once an accountant is working on your file.

Work the numbers first

  • Salary sacrifice

    What packaging more into super does to your take-home pay and your tax.

  • Capital gains tax

    What a sale costs outside super, which is usually the comparison that matters.

Other services

Company setup ABN application GST registration Bookkeeping Trust setup Partnership setup All services

Registered tax agent

A real practice, not a form that emails you a PDF

Every return is prepared and reviewed by a registered agent before it is lodged. Because we lodge on your behalf, you get the agent deadline rather than the 31 October one — that is roughly six extra months, and it is the single most common reason people switch.
